 625→        if requirement.obligation.value == "forbidden" and has_value:

 649→            findings.append(

 652→                    location,
 653→                    "forbidden claim type carries an actual statement",
 654→                )
 655→            )

 739→        }

 742→        }

 792→                )
 793→
 794→    required_fact_paths = {
 795→        item.fact_path
 796→        for item in substantive.fact_requirements
 797→        if item.obligation.value == "required"
 798→    }
 799→    required_claim_types = {
 800→        item.claim_type
 801→        for item in substantive.claim_requirements
 802→        if item.obligation.value == "required"
 803→    }
 804→    has_any_positive_content = (
 805→        any(
 806→            (fact.value or "").strip()
 807→            for fact in content.facts

- Required facts must have non-blank values; forbidden facts with values produce errors.
- Required claims must have statements; forbidden claims with statements produce errors.
- Evidence floors: a conforming evidence unit must satisfy role+admission+locator+context+quality. If no conforming unit → unsatisfied_evidence_requirement. Note it doesn't require one evidence unit per claim; one conforming unit per group suffices.
